story.title: Story 1: Full Migration And Entity Coverage

result.planSummary: Expanded the SQLite migration from the Story 0 smoke path into a full file-backed thread import that preserves turns, chunks, imports, projections, token/readiness metadata, and canonical content; added migration-time validation/downgrade rules for conflicting or invalid legacy state; and added SQLite-side managed-thread lookup fallback so migrated threads remain discoverable even when loose JSON maps are missing.

changedFiles.reason: Replaced the smoke-only importer with full snapshot migration, entity counting, validation warnings, derived-state downgrades, token metadata checks, and repeat-import handling.
Added authoritative SQLite thread scanning fallback so managed-thread lookup can resolve migrated threads without depending solely on `threadId-map.json`.
Added the `GENERATED_ROLLOUT_MISSING` issue code used by migration validation/reporting.
Added reusable legacy-fixture helpers for creating file-backed migration inputs across the new Story 1 tests.
Covered full migration preservation, actor conflict handling, repair-needed turn import, idempotent reruns, and managed-thread lookup fallback.
Covered valid derived-artifact preservation plus downgrade behavior for missing smooth/chunk provenance.
Covered exact/heuristic token metadata preservation and repair-needed surfacing for invalid token records.
Covered projection metadata import staying separate from generated rollout content plus missing-rollout warnings.
Covered preservation of readiness/token-counting issue audit state and resolved-ready state.
Updated the legacy smoke expectation to match full turn import now that Story 1 migration is no longer smoke-only.

findingsFixed: Replaced the partial Story 0 import with full entity coverage so turns, chunks, imports, projections, and embedded token/readiness state now migrate into SQLite.

Added explicit migration warnings and downgrade behavior for conflicting actors, inconsistent turns, invalid derived provenance, missing generated rollout files, and malformed token metadata instead of silently importing them as ready.
Removed the managed-thread lookup dependence on loose JSON maps alone by adding SQLite-side fallback scanning for migrated threads.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run story verification with attention on the migration warning/downgrade policy and the new SQLite managed-thread lookup fallback.
